prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original finished ultra-wide photographic banner for a designer's portfolio, 3:1 landscape, ideally 1536 x 512 pixels. This image is the banner artwork only, NOT a whole webpage, NOT a contact sheet. Full bleed, no outer margin, no rounded outer frame, no watermarks. Exceptional art-directed editorial product photography with realistic device mockups, correct device geometry and faithful interface branding. All major text and product features must fit within the center 88% of the image. The actual project interface described below is the authority for device screens. Creative scene photography is illustrative, not a claim about a real location, product outcome or study. Compact default Munchpal Food sharing banner. Warm oat tabletop, appealing reusable black lunch tray with rice, orange roasted vegetables, greens and tofu, one tilted black phone at right showing the ACTUAL app's visual identity: cream-white screen, green #008A57 circular food logo, exact wordmark 'MunchPal', strong orange #FF9E08 primary actions, Indonesian home heading 'Segera donasikan makanan lebih anda!', search, food category tiles and food donation listings, black bottom navigation with central plus button. Left simple charcoal sans-serif headline 'Good food' then 'goes further.' Fresh natural food photography, orange and green accents from actual app, soft daylight. Small horizontal strip readable at 450 x 110px, no floating ingredients, no giant phone outside frame.
